scope_recount.reconciliation: Recomputed directly from research/qgen/onboarding/v3_fresh36_supply_input_manifest.json by excluding the 8 opportunity_ids already attempted in the prior session from the 32-row ROUTE_B/ROUTE_C subset. Result is 24, one more than the brief's arithmetic; used the measured 24, listed explicitly in research/qgen/onboarding/v4_route_bc_wave2_raw_supply.json#remaining_opportunity_ids.

discovery_method: Reused scripts/qbank/profile_contrast_retrieval.build_retrieval_index (real function call, not reimplemented) over all 3 frozen curated seed packs (competitive_contrast_seed_pack_r4.json, _g2_extensions.json, _g2_targeted.json) to enumerate the full 81-row curated library's distinct anchor_study_unit_id/anchor_topic pairs, as a cheap filter applied before any clinical adjudication.
cheap_filter_finding: The entire curated library covers only 6 topics: SU-C-21 (Acute Coronary Syndrome), SU-GS-76 (Appendicitis), SU-OB-54 (Mastitis), SU-P-147 (Bronchiolitis), SU-PH-07 (Screening Principles and Screening Biases), SU-PS-12 (Depressive Disorders). None of the 24 remaining opportunities' study units overlap with, or are clinically related to, any of these 6.

independent_review.reason: Zero relations or feature extensions were proposed this wave, so there was nothing for a fresh, no-authorship-stake review subagent to adjudicate. MAXIMUM_SEMANTIC_SUBAGENT_CONCURRENCY=1 policy remains available but unused.

option_b_shared_plausibility_feature_ext.rationale: Option (b) requires an existing curated seed that is genuinely clinically plausible as a competitor for the opportunity, so a real evidence-grounded feature can be added to make its (already-defined) anchor gate fire. No such seed exists for any of the 24 remaining opportunities -- the cheap filter above is decisive and was verified via the real retrieval-index-building code, not assumed. Forcing a SHARED_PLAUSIBILITY_FEATURE between e.g. a dermatology stem and an appendicitis-pack competitor row would fabricate a clinical relationship not present in evidence, which the anti-hallucination contract forbids.

option_a_new_curated_seed_pack.rationale: Authoring a new curated-seed-pack-shaped file (targets/seeds + .enrichment.json + .stem_anchors.json, independently reviewed, hash-frozen) for even one of the 24 study units is a materially larger unit of work (competitor discovery, condition predicates, enrichment tags, stem-anchor authoring, independent review, hash freeze) than fits a bounded discovery-plus-review pass. Consistent with the prior session's judgment for the dermatology cluster; a deliberate scope decision, not an oversight.

v5_v6_registry.reason: No candidate survived to APPROVED status (none were proposed), so there is nothing to promote. FEATURE_ANCHOR_SNAPSHOT_V5 (research/qgen/onboarding/feature_anchor_snapshot_v5.json) is unchanged; no V6 was created.

supply_assessment: STRUCTURALLY_BLOCKED_ACROSS_THE_FULL_REMAINING_SET. Unlike the dermatology cluster (which had genuine clinically-related indexed competitors that failed only on citation-scope precision), none of these 24 opportunities have ANY curated seed that is even topically related to their own clinical content. The milestone's supply problem for Route B/C is not fixable by feature-map or registry extension alone for this remaining set; it requires new curated-seed-pack authoring (option a), which was judged out of scope for a single bounded wave.
